hypothesis: The three changes that let the Metal graph run a GGUF leave the model's own format (canonical.qc, experts.qc) as fast as before: a 512-token prompt on an 8 GB M1, with the same logits.
model: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (Qwen3_5MoeForConditionalGeneration) in Colibri's qwen36 container: INT4 routed experts with gs=64 group scales and f16 dense weights, canonical.qc beside it (1.94 GB of INT8 dense matrices, written on 2026-10-01) and experts.qc (17.1 GB, last written on 2026-10-07)
command: git archive <commit> c | tar -x -C <dir>, make -C <dir>/c qwen36_metal.o backend_metal.o METAL=1, then from the repository root, with the compiler flags make -C c qwen36 METAL=1 gives qwen36.c except its qpack path (-DQWEN36_QPACK and its objects, which the harness does not use): clang -O3 -Xclang -fopenmp -I<libomp>/include -Wall -Wextra -Wno-unused-parameter -Wno-misleading-indentation -Wno-unused-function -DCOLI_METAL -DQWEN36_METAL -I<dir>/c docs/experiments/qwen36-gguf-metal-2026-10-19/bench.c <dir>/c/qwen36_metal.o <dir>/c/backend_metal.o -o bin-<commit>/qwen36-bench -lm -L<libomp>/lib -lomp -framework Metal -framework Foundation -framework Accelerate -lc++; every run: /usr/bin/time -l env -i PATH=/usr/bin:/bin HOME=$HOME TEACHER=1 launchers/<name>/qwen36-bench chat.txt 64,512 32, where each launcher is a script of one line that sets SNAP and its variables and runs a harness; baseline = launchers/own-085b5fc4/, trial = launchers/own/: the same model directory and the same defaults, bin-085b5fc4/ against bin-08293922/

hardware.cpu: Apple M1, 4 performance + 4 efficiency cores (MacBook Air, MacBookAir10,1, no fan)

config.BUILD: the compiler flags of make -C c qwen36 METAL=1 on macOS without its qpack path: clang -O3 -Xclang -fopenmp -DCOLI_METAL -DQWEN36_METAL, qwen36_metal.o and backend_metal.o
config.PROMPT: the first 64 and the first 512 tokens of chat.txt (an English conversation written for these measurements, plain User:/Assistant: text, read whole; prompt_hash is its SHA-256), each from an empty state; after each, 32 tokens, each fed the text's own next token (teacher forcing: both versions read the same tokens)
config.ORDER: 1 warm-up run of the baseline (discarded; both versions read the same file), then baseline trial trial baseline baseline trial trial baseline, one process each
config.REST: thermal state nominal, then 60 s, before every run
config.EXPERT_CACHE: the Metal graph's default: a sixteenth of the RAM, 512 MiB: 303 slots of 1.77 MB
config.SNAP: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, Colibri qwen36 container, INT4 experts gs=64, internal SSD
config.MEASURED: tokens per second reading the 512-token prompt from an empty state
config.ENGINE_COMMIT: 085b5fc4, the base of the three GGUF changes

quality.method: Correctness: the GGUF changes leave the model's own format as it was: both versions give the same logits, bit for bit (the same fingerprint in every run of both). Fingerprints of every logit and hashes of the tokens (baseline / trial), each the same in every run of its version: 64 tokens acf56a9f12e2dad6/f55beb9e5e71ac78 / acf56a9f12e2dad6/f55beb9e5e71ac78, 512 tokens 37bdb7f78811da2a/99b2135657766012 / 37bdb7f78811da2a/99b2135657766012; the 32 tokens' mean negative log-likelihood and top-1 rate (baseline / trial): after 64 tokens 2.02645 0.594 / 2.02645 0.594, after 512 tokens 1.85974 0.469 / 1.85974 0.469.
